{{Quote|General, there's a fleet of Star Destroyers coming out of hyperspace in Sector Four.|Romas Navander, to General Carlist Rieekan|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''Romas "Lock" Navander''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Originally from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Navander graduated from the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] before defecting to the Rebel Alliance. Navander was eventually stationed at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], the hidden [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters on the remote [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Under the authority of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], Navander worked as a [[tech communications officer]], helping to relay orders to Rebel [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

Navander first detected the arrival of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Imperial Death Squadron]] in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]] just prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], reporting his finding to Rieekan as Echo Base prepared to evacuate in the face of an imminent [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ground assault. During the Hoth battle, Navander publicly announced to Echo Base the safe escape of the first [[Quantum Storm/Legends|Rebel evacuation transport]] before personally helping to escort four more [[Transport/Legends|transports]] past the Imperial [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] in Hoth's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]]. When he turned back to help escort a fifth transport, a pair of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] destroyed his Y-wing. Although Navander safely [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejected]], he was captured by a nearby [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].

==Biography==
===Echo Base communications officer===
{{Quote|Reroute all power to the energy shield.|General Carlist Rieekan, to Romas Navander, in response to Death Squadron's arrival in the Hoth system|<ref name="ESB" />}}
[[File:NavanderProbeDroid-ESB.png|thumb|left|275px|Romas Navander (far right), flanking General Carlist Rieekan, looks on as Echo Base learns of the Imperial probe droid.]]
Romas "Lock" Navander was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="ESB" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies" /> [[Corellian/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="CSWE-Romas Navander" /> in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Shortly after graduating from the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], Navander, a skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], defected from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] service and joined the revolutionary [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CSWE-Romas Navander" /> As a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], he served the Rebellion at the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command's]] secret [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|74|Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth}}</ref> on the remote [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] from the facility's command center. Working under the direction of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]],<ref name="ESB" /> [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of all Alliance forces in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]],<ref name="CSWE-Carlist Rieekan">{{CSWECite|III|100|Rieekan, General Carlist}}</ref> Navander played an important role as [[tech communications officer]],<ref name="CSWE-Romas Navander" /> responsible for coordinating and relaying orders<ref name="Who's Who" /> to nearby Rebel [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="CSWE-Romas Navander" /> In that capacity, he worked closely with Commander [[Tamizander Rey]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> Echo Base's senior [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]], who oversaw [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] operations.<ref name="CSWE-Tamizander Rey">{{CSWECite|III|98|Rey, Tamizander}}</ref>

Navander joined Rieekan in Echo Base's command center<ref name="ESB" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> to listen in on a conversation via [[Comlink/Legends|communicator]] between [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] concerning the presence of an Imperial [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] outside the base. Realizing that the Empire had discovered the base's existence, Rieekan reluctantly remarked to Navander that the Alliance had best begin to evacuate from Hoth.<ref name="ESB" />

Shortly thereafter, Navander, working in the command center, detected the arrival of<ref name="ESB" /> [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]]<ref name="CSWE-Darth Vader">{{CSWECite|III|288&ndash;290|Vader, Darth}}</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], led by his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']],<ref name="Atlas" /> in the Hoth [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="ESB" /> After urgently gesturing for Rieekan to look at his [[Computer/Legends|computer]] console,<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> Navander reported to the general the imminent Imperial threat bearing down on the planet. In response, Rieekan ordered Navander to reroute the base's power supply to the Rebels' [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|energy shield]] in defense of a potential [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]].<ref name="ESB" />

===Battle of Hoth===
{{Quote|The first transport is away. The first transport is away.|Romas Navander, during the Battle of Hoth|audio=Navander-Transport.flac|<ref name="ESB" />}}
[[File:Navander_Button.png|thumb|right|275px|With General Rieekan monitoring, Romas Navander detects the arrival of Death Squadron in the Hoth system.]]
During the early stages of the Rebels' subsequent [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|evacuation of Hoth]], Navander declared to the base over the central public address system that the facility had gone to full alert status after [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] had indicated Imperial landings beyond Echo Base's perimeter. He also announced the departure of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group's]] [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]] en route to meet the Imperial invasion force. Moments later,<ref name="ESB script">[[The Empire Strikes Back: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''The Empire Strikes Back'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref> Navander reported to the base that the first Rebel [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|evacuation transport]] to depart the planet,<ref name="Who's Who" /> the [[Quantum Storm/Legends|''Quantum Storm'']],<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> had safely escaped the [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="Who's Who" /> after slipping through the Imperial [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] in Hoth's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] under the protective fire of Echo Base's [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|planetary ion cannon]].<ref name="ESB" />

From there, Navander took command of one of the base's [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] and helped to escort four more [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump point,<ref name="Who's Who" /> where they would proceed to the Rebels' predetermined [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous point]].<ref name="ESB" /> However, when Navander turned back to escort a fifth transport, a pair of Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] destroyed his Y-wing. Navander safely [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejected]] from his craft, but he was captured by a nearby [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Who's Who" />

==Personality and traits==
Romas "Lock" Navander was one<ref name="CSWE-Romas Navander" /> of many<ref name="CSWE-Corellian system">{{CSWECite|I|143|Corellian system}}</ref> skilled Corellian pilots.<ref name="CSWE-Romas Navander" /> After graduating from the Imperial Academy, Navander joined the Rebellion, where his piloting abilities were put to good use in the Alliance's evacuation from Hoth. Navander personally helped to escort four transports to safety in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of a Y-wing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="Who's Who" />

Navander had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that was graying with age, blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin.<ref name="ESB" />

==Equipment==
During his service [[Time/Legends|time]] at Echo Base, Navander wore the standard-issue [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|cold-weather fatigues]] of Hoth personnel, including the [[Armor/Legends|uniform's]] [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|padded vest]], [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|lightweight tunic]], [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|leggings]], and [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|boots]]. While working at his control console when he detected the arrival of the Imperial fleet in the Hoth system, Navander wore [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|gloves]] and a [[Headset comlink|headset]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Notable appearances===
Romas Navander appears in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] as the Echo Base [[Controller/Legends|controller]] who first detects the presence of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader's Star Destroyers in the Hoth system just prior to the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="ESB" /> Navander's first appearance came in [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]],<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> just prior to the film's release.<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> The character's name, backstory, and role in the film were first established on the [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/romaslocknavander.gif "Romas 'Lock' Navander" card] from the [[November]] [[1996]] ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="Hoth Limited">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Romas "Lock" Navander}}</ref>

===Actor discrepancy===
[[File:Delgoren.png|thumb|left|230px|Actor Burnell Tucker, who portrayed Romas Navander, also played Rebel character Del Goren in ''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope''.]]
The [[2004]] article [[Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth|''Who's Who in Echo Base'']], written by [[Josh Radke]] for [[Star Wars Insider 74|''Star Wars Insider'' 74]], claims that Romas Navander is played by actor [[Jerry Harte]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> who is credited in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' as "Head Controller" in the Rebel Forces.<ref name="ESB" /> The article also notes that Harte would go on to play the character [[W:c:indianajones:Stanton|Professor Stanton]] in the [[1989]] film [[Wikipedia:Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade|''Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade'']], a part of [[Lucasfilm]]'s other popular [[Wikipedia:Indiana Jones (franchise)|movie franchise]].<ref name="Who's Who" />

The actor who portrays Navander in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' is, in fact, [[Burnell Tucker]],<ref name="Actor">This assertion is based on a visual comparison of actors [[Burnell Tucker]] and [[Jerry Harte]], using pictures of both men in their respective various acting roles (see: [http://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=24795 Burnell Tucker] and [http://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=37407 Jerry Harte]). Comparing both actors demonstrates that Tucker played [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] character [[Del Goren/Legends|Del Goren]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] [[Controller/Legends|controllers]] Romas Navander and [[Wyron Serper/Legends|Wyron Serper]] in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], and that Harte played an [[Unidentified Rebel major|unnamed Rebel officer]] in ''The Empire Strikes Back''. Therefore, the claim from the [[Star Wars Insider 74|''Star Wars Insider'' 74]] article [[Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth|''Who's Who in Echo Base'']] that Harte played Navander is incorrect.</ref> who is credited in the film as one of several "Other Officers" in the Rebel Forces.<ref name="ESB" /> Tucker also plays the character [[Wyron Serper/Legends|Wyron Serper]],<ref name="Actor" /> another Echo Base controller in ''The Empire Strikes Back'',<ref name="Who's Who" /> as well as the Rebel character [[Del Goren/Legends|Del Goren]] in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. Meanwhile, Harte plays [[Unidentified Rebel major|another Echo Base controller]] who was not given a name in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]].<ref name="Actor" /> This character appears as the lone male controller still in the Echo Base command center when Princess Leia issues the final evacuation code signal at the end of the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="ESB" />

Tucker and Harte appear together in ''The Empire Strikes Back'', surrounding General Rieekan actor [[Bruce Boa]], during the scene in which Han Solo communicates with Princess Leia to report that he has destroyed the Imperial [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]]. In this scene, seen [[:File:NavanderProbeDroid-ESB.png|here]], Harte is facing camera, while Tucker is standing over Boa's left shoulder.<ref name="ESB" />

===Character development and inconsistencies===
The article ''Who's Who in Echo Base'' expands upon Navander's role at the Battle of Hoth based on the character's original ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game information, including identifying him as the P.A. voice that announces the successful evacuation of the first transport during the battle.<ref name="Who's Who" /> However, actor [[Mark Hamill]], who plays [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]], actually voices the announcement in the film.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Fact!">{{InsiderCite|119|The Empire Strikes Fact!|The Empire Strikes ''Fact!''}}</ref>

[[File:Not_Rieekan_and_Navander.jpg|thumb|right|230px|A ''Star Wars: Rebel Assault'' cutscene mirrors film footage of General Rieekan and Romas Navander from ''The Empire Strikes Back''.]]
Navander's scene in which he reports the arrival of the Imperial fleet to General Rieekan appears in the film and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]],<ref name="ESB" /><ref name="ESB junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> but it is not included in the original ''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization or [[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|radio drama]].<ref name="ESB novel" /><ref name="Fire and Ice">{{ESBRadio|Fire and Ice}}</ref> The [[1995]] young readers novel [[Classic Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (Random House)|''Classic Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'']], adapted by [[Larry Weinberg]], includes an Echo Base loudspeaker address announcing, "Imperial Star Destroyers coming out of hyperspace in Sector Four!", clearly inspired from the character's film dialogue. However, this announcement is not necessarily attributable to the Navander character.<ref name="Classic Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back">[[Classic Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (Random House)|''Classic Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> Additionally, the radio drama includes the announcement of the first evacuation transport's escape as well as an additional line attributable to Navander announcing the launch of Rogue Group at the advent of the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="Fire and Ice" />

[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 12|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 12]], published by [[De Agostini]] on [[March 20]], [[2002]],<ref name="FFDate">{{FFdates|12}}</ref> includes a picture insert of Navander from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' scene in which he detects the arrival of the Imperial fleet. However, the character in this picture is misidentified as Wyron Serper.<ref name="FF12">{{FactFile|12|REG 1-2|The Alliance Regroups}}</ref>

The [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'' features a cutscene that reuses footage of Navander and Rieekan from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' to depict two Rebel characters in a similar setting. The cutscene replaces the heads of Navander and Rieekan with those of a [[Unidentified Gamma Base commander|commander]] and his [[Unidentified Gamma Base communications officer|communications officer]].<ref name="Rebel Assault">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]''</ref>

[[2014]]'s ''[[Star Wars in 100 Scenes]]'' erroneously uses an image of Navander to identify another character, [[Beryl Chiffonage]].<ref name="100Scenes">''[[Star Wars in 100 Scenes]]''</ref>
